merge_summary: pos-full and pos-solo merged into the formint-pos package with the same Tauri shell architecture. Backend now uses Django Ninja + ninja-extra for the API (fusion encoder/decoder for all responses) and django-fusion data components (tables + forms) for HTMX fragments.
merge_notes: Sidecar merge: backend/ merged into sidecar/ (single Django project — pos_full app + formint app unified onto one model layer via formint.models re-exporting pos_full models). Admin unified on formint/admin.py (superset of the old configs/admin.py). Dead React frontends (legacy-react/pos-full, legacy-react/pos-solo) removed — the Astro + Alpine + HTMX shell in frontend/ is canonical. Rust Diesel ORM removed from both editions; data layer is Django models + Robyn/django-bolt APIs.

pos-solo.path: removed (was ../pos-solo; React code archived under legacy-react/pos-solo, since deleted)

pos-full.path: removed (was ../pos-full; React code archived under legacy-react/pos-full, since deleted)

legacy-react.status: removed — superseded by the Astro + Alpine + HTMX frontend

backend_stack.migrations: Django migrations (astro style: initial schema + data migrations)
